**Subject:** 1:1 to discuss recent performance and support

Hi Alex,

I’d like to schedule a 1:1 this week to talk about how things have been going this quarter. I want to be upfront that this is a performance discussion so it isn’t a surprise.

There are a few specific items I’d like us to review:  
• Persona V3 integration was due March 15 and shipped March 28.  
• The evaluation pipeline was due April 1 and is still not complete.  
• Code reviews have been lighter than expected; several complex PRs received only one‑line “LGTM” comments.  
• You missed two standups without notice, and there were a few occasions where you were unavailable on Teams for 3+ hours during core hours.

I’m raising this because you were a top performer last year — you led the Persona V2 launch, mentored two juniors, and earned an “Exceeds” rating. So this change stands out, and I want to understand what’s behind it. If something has changed or you’re dealing with blockers or personal constraints, please let me know. My goal is to support you and get us back on track.

In the meeting I’d like us to: (1) discuss what’s contributing to the missed commitments, (2) clarify expectations for delivery, code review quality, and communication, and (3) agree on a short plan to improve over the next few weeks. Please come ready to share your perspective and any support you need.

Are you available Thursday at 2pm? If not, suggest a time that works.

Thanks,  
[Name]
